profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer @ GE Aerospace
profile.summary: Computer Scientist / Engineer with an interest for anything in code testing / development. Plus interest in any subjects involving mathematics, game design, and music. Graduated with Bachelor's in Computer Science @ University of Central Florida, and worked extensively in Robotics, Space Systems, and Video Games. I have an obsession and passion for SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) roles and find them to be a crucial part of any development lifecycle. Whether this includes troubleshooting / debugging / writing automation for testing, I'm always interested and will take on the task

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer for LM Space Software Factory (GPS, SmartSat, Wildfire T1, GPS Crosslink etc.). DevOps of large codebase repos consisting of C++ and Python code for common satellite software. IT/UT testing of software, usage of kernel device drivers, artifact maintenance for a yocto-based distribution system, cross-team interaction and implementation of SmartSat general SDK for other programs, and pre-ATLO testing and maintenance for customer product release.
positions.insights: Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA), Critical Thinking and +21 skills

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Ground Station Engineer for S2E2 and supporting systems integration lab. Develop, test, and maintain the Air Force's defense system to provide global coverage of missile detection and tracking.
positions.insights: Critical Thinking, Hardware Diagnostics and +12 skills

positions.title: UE5 Programmer
positions.description: C++ development and integration with UE5 for an upcoming multiplayer hybrid FPS/RTS video game. AI pathfinding / commanding, general UI, networking replication, event automation, and integration of other FPS/RTS game mechanics.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Developed and maintained a VR research simulation in Unreal Engine 4, Visual Studio Code, and C++ code. Interface design, creation of levels/sublevels, basic functionality of simulation, AI pathfinding, data serialization/messaging, and data collection within the simulation. Other projects were more hardware-based dealing with robotics and sensory equipment.

projects.title: Low Level C++ Game Engine / Game
projects.description: VampireSurvivors-like game in basic C++ code. Small project to get into more expertise in general game design mechanics like: Dynamic game asset rendering, basic menu actions, dynamic dll loading and realtime hot reloading of code, Observer-like pattern for callbacks, event handling, and code decoupling, basic sprite rendering, sprite creation, basic player controls, and enemy sprite interactions with player.
